import struct

                raw = d[offset:offset+4]
                value = struct.unpack('>f', raw)[0]
                print(f'lbl_{address:08X} file_offset=0x{offset:X} bytes={raw.hex().upper()} float={value.hex()}')
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break
    if not found:
        print(f'lbl_{address:08X} unverified: not file-backed')
